title: Wing Wiring — Leading Edge Harnesses and Anti-Ice Valve Feeds

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Wiring diagram for the wing leading edge harnesses, including the anti-ice shut-off valve feeds, the position sensing returns and the support positions that change with the high force solenoid standard.

sections.purpose: Wiring diagram of the wing leading edge harnesses, covering the anti-ice shut-off valve feeds, the position sensing returns and the slat area equipment.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking forward at the left hand leading edge with the access panels removed; the right hand side is the mirror image. The valve branch is shown in both support standards: the original clamp position and the position 40 mm inboard used with the high force solenoid. The greyed clamp is the original. A branch drawn with a dashed outline exists only on aircraft carrying the heated seat provision and is not present on most of the fleet.
sections.routing_note: The leading edge run enters at the wing root and follows the front spar outboard, dropping to each valve position through the access bay. Clamp positions are given for both solenoid standards and the correct set must be taken from the aircraft configuration. The run is not co-routed with any hydraulic line and crosses the piccolo duct only at the positions shown, with the standoff called out at each crossing.
